name: 100% Pure Grade A Amber Maple Syrup (Pure Tree Sap)
whyItWorks: 100% pure boiled maple tree sap. Unlike commercial pancake syrups made of high-fructose corn syrup, pure maple syrup is predominantly sucrose with mineral trace elements (manganese and zinc). It contains 0g fiber, zero artificial sweeteners, and is certified low-FODMAP.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1–2 tablespoons over oatmeal, pancakes, Cream of Rice, or waffles. Avoid pancake syrups sweetened with sorbitol or high-fructose corn syrup.
watchOuts: Read label carefully: must state '100% Pure Maple Syrup', not 'Maple-Flavored Corn Syrup'.
